selection: minimum whole-field validation MSE; test only after best epoch selection
checkpoint_policy: best weights held in memory; no checkpoint files
scope: within-flow time-block generalization; no cross-flow generalization claim
evaluation_mask: Intersection of geometric validity masks across all scales; identical per slice for all methods and dropout rates.
temporal_policy: Frozen 1.1 time blocks; no training/validation/test integration or source-frame overlap. Reused benchmark, not a new confirmation set.
dropout_placement: Dropout2d after each UNet DoubleConv block (5 locations), or after each ESPCN hidden activation (2 locations). No output or input dropout.
